This Land Acquisition Appeal Having Been Finally Heard On
09.01.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:
Special Tahsildar La Railways ... vs Somanathan on 9 January, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103146033/
This appeal is filed by the State with a delay of 350 days.

As per the dictum laid down by the Division
Bench of this Court in the case of State of Kerala and another vs. Kool Foam Pvt. Ltd. and anoth

entities.text: State of Kerala and another vs. Kool Foam Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: , the delay of more than 120 days will be hit by the embargo in section 74 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Hence the delay condonation petition seeking to condone the delay of 350 days is legally unsustainable and it is dismissed.
Consequently, the L.A.Appeal is also dismissed.
